ModMetaData.name: VPE - Paladin
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Paladin psycaster path to Vanilla Psycasts Expanded: a holy frontline class of smites, blessings and consecrated ground, along with two permanent passive nodes.
Abilities - Smite - a ranged strike that hits for a share of the caster's own melee damage. Double damage against Anomaly entities, ghouls and shamblers. - Divine Grace (passive) - fewer mental breaks, and the ones that happen end sooner. Works on enemy-inflicted berserk and fear too. - Lay on Hands - a touch heal. Melee range only, self or ally. - Consecration - hallowed ground around the Paladin that burns the unholy and speeds allied healing. - Divine Weapon - temporary melee damage and attack speed. - Divine Health (passive) - immunity to age-related illness and a large immunity gain bonus. - Divine Shield - brief, total protection from incoming violence behind a golden barrier. - Angelic Aspect - gain a short winged leap over any terrain, set struck foes alight, take less damage. - Judgement - a pillar of holy light dealing fire and physical damage across an area.
Most values scale with the caster's psychic sensitivity.
Requires Vanilla Psycasts Expanded. Anomaly is optional but grants the "unholy" bonus against entities.
